name: Bing Ads
shortInfo: PPC advertising platform used to display ads based on the keywords
brief: Microsoft Advertising is a pay-per-click (PPC) advertising platform used to display ads based on the keywords used in a user's search query. For advertisers placing a large number of ads or developers building advertising tools, the Bing Ads API provides programmatic access to Microsoft Advertising. Using the Bing Ads API is the most efficient way to manage many large campaigns or to integrate your marketing with other in-house systems. Some organizations may choose a hybrid approach; using the web UI for most tasks but automating reporting or campaign optimization with the API
about:
Reach people in a task-oriented mindset who have a higher buying power, spend more online, and are more likely to engage with ads to try new offers. Create personalised experiences using powerful audience intelligence and platform capabilities that improve campaign performance.  
  
Learn more about [Bing Ads API documentation.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/advertising/guides/?view=bingads-13)
availableData:
[Account Performance Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/account-performance-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing long-term account performance and trends.

[Ad Dynamic Text Performance Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/ad-dynamic-textperformancereport.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing which dynamic text strings are performing well and which strings you should consider changing.

[Ad Extension By Ad Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/ad-extension-by-ad-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing how well different versions of your ad extensions are performing with each ad.

[Ad Extension By Keyword Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/ad-extension-by-keyword-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing how well different versions of your ad extensions are performing for each keyword.

[Ad Extension Detail Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/ad-extension-detail-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing the effectiveness of individual ad extension items, for example each link of a sitelink extension.

[Ad Group Performance Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/pipelines/ad-group-performance-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve reports detailing broad comparisons of delivery performance statistics by ad group, campaign, or account attributes rather than at the keyword level.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/bing-ads/index.html) here.
